study type: Secondary analysis of a cohort study (Riyadh Mother and Baby cohort study)
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes are associated with both adolescent and advanced maternal age, with adolescents more likely to have vaginal deliveries but also preterm delivery, and older mothers at increased risk of cesarean delivery, gestational diabetes, and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Adolescents were more likely to have vaginal delivery and least likely to deliver by caesarean section, while women ≥40 years were more likely to deliver by caesarean section.
